title: Dying in Mall Worlds
content: Most if not all of what I remember from experiencing what I've discovered as mall worlds usually is toward the end of my time there. I can remember a lot of it for awhile, but then it mostly fades away except for the bigger experiences like the end. In multiple occasions I've died in these worlds, and that's the last time I see those worlds again, sent off to a different one. Does anyone else experience this? (This is my first post on reddit so hopefully I did it right)
